subject: Mutual Action Plan & Stakeholder Map - FinPay next steps

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + MAP template

Hi Sarah / Olivia -

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we can align with your procurement and security timelines: 

Key points from today's call:
- Primary use case: real-time fraud detection enrichment on authorization flows (low latency, high throughput).
- Success criteria: 95th pct latency < 200ms, < $0.0005/token cost target for enrichment calls, and SOC2 evidence for security review.
- Current tech constraints: FinPay runs in us-west, expects on-prem/private deployment for PCI scope.

Stakeholder map (who we heard today):
- Sarah Lee - Head of Payments / Economic buyer
- Olivia Chen - Security lead (infosec)
- Procurement contact still TBD - Sarah to confirm

Immediate next steps I propose:
1) I attached a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) template (FinPay_MAP_v1.xlsx) - can you review and add owner/times for each milestone?
2) Sarah / Olivia: can you confirm procurement timeline and whether we should loop in vendor security questionnaire (we can provide SOC2_summary.pdf and SOC2 controls mapping)?
3) Camila and I will draft a stakeholder map and proposed milestone dates based on your inputs and send an updated MAP by Fri.
4) Schedule a 30-min follow-up next week to review the MAP and procurement ask; please share availability.

Attachments: FinPay_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP template), SOC2_summary.pdf (high-level controls)

Thanks - small request: if procurement wants standard net-30 vs net-45, flag that in your reply so we can reflect in the commercial section.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa - appreciate the clear recap. A few quick items: 

- I added Devin O'Neill (devin.oneill@finpay.com) from Procurement to this thread - he'll be handling terms/timeline.
- Olivia: can you confirm which SOC2 artifacts you'll need? We prefer a short controls mapping and the SOC report; if Redwood can provide a one-page mapping that would speed review.
- Timeline: our target is to complete vendor selection and procurement signoff by mid-May (approx 5/15). Security review will run in parallel and may take 2 weeks once we have the mapping.

I'll get our procurement intake form and preferred vendor terms uploaded by EOD tomorrow. For payment terms, FinPay prefers net-30 but can consider net-45 for annual contracts if we need to.
